name: Why shouldn't I try to fix storm damage myself?

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I try to fix storm damage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempting to fix storm damage yourself without proper experience and equipment can lead to several problems. You risk personal injury, especially with electrical issues or structural instability. Improper repairs can exacerbate the damage, leading to more costly issues like mold growth or compromised structural integrity. Furthermore, DIY repairs might not meet building codes or insurance requirements, potentially jeopardizing your claim. Professional restorers have the expertise, safety equipment, and knowledge to ensure a complete and lasting repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY storm damage repairs risk injury, worsen damage, may not meet codes or insurance standards, and can lead to more costly problems like mold.
